description: This file defines the 'Backup' class within the OpenCart admin cron controllers. It provides an 'index' method to schedule a backup task by interacting with the 'setting/task' model.

classes.name: Backup
classes.description: Controller class for scheduling backup tasks within the admin cron namespace.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Schedules a backup task by calling the 'addTask' method of the 'setting/task' model with predefined task data.
